scope: Diagnostic baseline trace and first experimental producer shape-cache screen; not accepted as final implementation

producer_submission_trace.finding: All measured C1 producer submissions reuse captured graphs. CPU submission differences are only a few microseconds, insufficient to explain the production-stage loss; GPU versus completion polling is being measured.

localization: The persistent loss is concentrated in the eight index-selection layers (2, 8, 14, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36). Ordinary SWA layers change only 1–4 us. The distributed pass omitted enabling the existing index query shape cache; the single-GPU pass already enables it. Testing that wiring correction plus bounded selection graph reuse.
